queries.label: control_100pc_poe5
queries.what: inside 100 pc, parallax/error >= 5 (control: GCNS keeps 302,239 of these after its own cleaning)
queries.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax >= 10 AND parallax_over_error >= 5

queries.label: shell_1000ly_any
queries.what: 100 pc to 1,000 ly, any parallax quality
queries.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax >= 3.261563777 AND parallax < 10

queries.adql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax >= 3.261563777 AND parallax < 10 AND parallax_over_error >= 5
